export_model_torchscript: export a detectron2 model to TorchScript format for deployment using tracing or scripting
export_model_onnx: export a detectron2 model to ONNX format for cross-framework deployment using caffe2 tracing
export_model_caffe2: export a detectron2 model to Caffe2 protobuf format and save the model graph visualization
run_evaluation_exported_model: run evaluation on an exported model using the COCOEvaluator and print metrics in CSV format
setup_detectron2_config: setup and freeze a detectron2 config from a config file with command-line options merged
